subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and goal continuation as core runtime features now, and should the paired implementation land as one broad PR or be split into staged PRs?
rationale: The request spans core agent runtime, gateway protocol/events, Control UI, Slack/Telegram delivery, config/default behavior, and plan-mode security boundaries, so automation cannot infer the intended product and rollout shape.

options.title: Stage the rollout
options.body: Keep this hub open and require focused question, plan, and goal PRs or commit groups with separate proof and review for each surface.

options.title: Sponsor the full branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and finish proof, CI, and rollout review on the paired implementation PR.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Maintain the hub but defer goal continuation or plan-mode pieces if maintainers want only structured questions or smaller plugin/API seams first.

recommendation.title: Stage the rollout
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open and require focused question, plan, and goal PRs or commit groups with separate proof and review for each surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the current Codex user-input bridge, session goals, and update_plan/strict-agentic policy surfaces.
